title: The first literal ambient projective-line contraction
statement: For the rational coefficient selected by l,c in [def-sfb-rational-tate-pullback-comparison], a separated finite-type Y over a field of positive characteristic different from l, with the Noetherian and diagonal-localization hypotheses in the Lean statement, let family be a coefficient family with a whole completed reference [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference] for a completed arrow delta. For one M in Loc(Dbc(P1_Y,Lambda)), and two arrows eta,epsilon normalized by the exact unitComponent_M and counitComponent_(Rq_*M) formulas of [def-sfb-projective-ambient-unit-counit-composites], Rq_*(eta) followed by epsilon equals Rq_* of identity_M tensor the first diagonal integral. The integral uses support1.hom, R1.map of the diagram class, and trace1, conjugated by singleUnitIso and the right unitor, exactly as in the attached Lean statement. No pair of natural transformations or twisted adjunction is assumed, and no limit property of delta is needed. Diagram carries integration fields, but this calculation uses neither integration nor triangle identities.

proof.text: Apply rationalP1_unit_factorization to the normalized proposed unit without opening its old normalization predicate in the assembly. Obtain native invertibility proofs hb,hp together with eta = a followed by v, where a is firstKernelInsertion at the selected diagonal class and v is the native tensor-shift/inverse projection/inverse exchange tail. This equality is before Rq_*, independent of a counit or trace.

Apply rationalP1_first_trace_transport to the normalized proposed counit epsilon and hb,hp. It supplies invertibility h1 of the fixed first projection and identifies Rq_*(v) followed by epsilon with firstTerminalFunctional at the first trace, before any diagonal class insertion. Its existential datum is a proof, not an object choice.

Functor.map_comp and associativity rewrite Rq_*(eta) followed by epsilon as Rq_*(a) followed by Rq_*(v) followed by epsilon. Substitute terminal trace transport. Apply first_section_tensor_evaluation at the selected coefficient, the Tate kernel, the diagram delta and its first trace. This gives precisely the original right-unitor-conjugated coefficient composite under Rq_*. All intermediate composites have their literal native endpoints fixed in Lean; no integration identity is used.

proof_origin.place: First identity assembled from normalized unit factorization, terminal trace transport and arbitrary supported-kernel evaluation at the selected coefficient.

theorem rationalP1_first_ambient_contraction
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (family : Family l Y) (_reference : Reference l Y δ family)
    (M : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)))
    (_hM : CategoryTheory.localizingClosure
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)) M)
    (η : M ⟶ (twist (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)
      (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))).obj
        ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj
          ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj M)))
    (ε : (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj
      ((twist (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y) (line l c (ProjectiveLine Y))).obj
        ((moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj
          ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X
            (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj M))) ⟶
        (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj M)
    (_hη : UnitComponentNormalized (coefficient l c).X Y (line l c) (diagram l c Y family)
      (secondLineComparison l c k p hpl Y) M η)
    (_hε : CounitComponentNormalized (coefficient l c).X Y (line l c)
      (diagram l c Y family)
      ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj M) ε) :
    (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map η ≫ ε =
      (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map
        ((ρ_ M).inv ≫ (M ◁
          ((singleUnitIso (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)).inv ≫
            (diagram l c Y family).support₁.hom ≫
            (diagram l c Y family).R₁.R.map (diagram l c Y family).delta ≫
            (diagram l c Y family).trace₁ ≫
            (singleUnitIso (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)).hom)) ≫ (ρ_ M).hom)
